title: Brokers, sub-brokers rules and regulations
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Brokers, sub-brokers rules and regulations Nov 16, 1992| Circulars SMD-II(B)/13/11464/92 November 16, 1992 To, The President/Executive Director Bombay, Ahmedabad, Calcutta, Madras, Delhi, Hyderabad, Madhya Pradesh, Bangalore, Cochin, Uttar Pradesh, Pune, Saurashtra-Kutch, Ludhiana, Gauhati, Mangalore, Magadh, Jaipur, Bhubaneshwar, Vadodara, Coimbatore, Meerut Stock Exchanges and OTC Exchange of India. Dear Sir, Brokers, sub-brokers rules and regulations Please find enclosed one copy of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Stock Brokers & Sub-Brokers) Rules, 1992 and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Stock Brokers & Sub-Brokers) Regulations, 1992. Kindly acknowledge the receipt of this letter. Yours faithfully, sd/- C B BHAVE encl : as above
